First-homology vanishing over all fields is not simple connectivity; a complete explicit free-collapse and pi_1-relator certificate is a topologically meaningful upgrade. Alongside the earlier cyclic class it differentiates the two order-five isotopy types by 64 versus 60 two-spheres without inventing an infinite generalization.
